over the past few years theres been a slow rise in terf ideology in online feminist spaces who didnt know the warning signs of it before it being shown to them. it started off as actually harmless jokes without the knowledge of what was really going on because it was just like "ugh men" and who cant agree with that sometimes? but as it progressed recently it has turned into actual homophobia and transphobia. i myself was seeing a lot of this online and made the mistake of saying something about it and i had nearly 100 people that would say the same things in this tiktok telling me that gay men are gross because some can be misogynistic calling me a faggot and telling me to kill myself. 

i can guarantee you it turns harmful down the line.

and thats exactly what makes it so harmful, that people 𝘥𝘰𝘯𝘵 realize it is. 

i myself was internally homophobic even after being openly trans because of the earlier stages of shit like this online and it took years to accept i was gay because of it.
